_about: Running checklist of every issue that has slipped through before. EVERY new video is checked against the FULL list (make_video.py writes the result into the report as known_issues, and the visual self-review reads the 'look_for' lines). Add a line whenever a new kind of problem is found; never delete one.

issues.issue: echo / reverb / roomy voice
short (<100 ms) audio blips/clicks at segment joins
pace changes between scenes (reported only: ElevenLabs' delivery is kept as is)
words dragging or rushed inside a line
uniform robotic pauses
mispronounced / garbled words, wrong Sanskrit names
captions out of sync with speech
scene cut in the middle of a word
music too loud under the voice / never rises in gaps
licence / attribution text burned into frames
issues.look_for: any credit, CC licence, ©, site name or URL drawn on the picture

issues.issue: leftover debug / placeholder text (undefined, NaN, TODO, {{...}})
issues.look_for: placeholder, debug or template text, a raw id or file name on screen

issues.issue: captions colliding with other text
issues.look_for: a label, number or title touching or under the caption slip

issues.issue: captions cut off / outside the safe zone / low contrast
issues.look_for: a caption clipped at a frame edge or hidden by the Reels UI zone

issues.issue: large empty zones while content crowds one part of the 9:16 frame
issues.look_for: a big empty band (top/bottom third) while everything is crammed elsewhere

issues.issue: old-film blur / grain / vignette / scratches
issues.look_for: soft, blurred, grainy or vignetted frames that are not a transition

issues.issue: jerky motion, frozen footage, sudden jumps
visual doesn't show what the line says (filler)
issues.look_for: a picture that doesn't match its narration line

issues.issue: a staged action reads wrong (e.g. Arjuna aiming his drawn bow at Krishna)
issues.look_for: characters doing something that contradicts the story or looks hostile/absurd

issues.issue: important text hidden under captions or other elements
issues.look_for: a label or number partly covered

issues.issue: cover frame is a transition blur or unreadable
Hindi/Hinglish words in an English script
weak opening hook (not the tournament winner / under the bar)
iCloud replaced the .venv-tts / output symlinks (pipeline hangs)
mixed per scene: the base style's own version of a borrowed scene bleeds through dissolves
issues.look_for: two scenes' text garbled together during a transition

issues.issue: mixed per scene: captions not following the scene's own style zone (land on its stat/label/icon)
issues.look_for: a caption sitting on a style's label, stat or main icon

issues.issue: in-world prop text (clapper, sign, label) framed into the caption band in tight shots
issues.look_for: a caption sitting on top of text painted on a prop (clapperboard, sign, scoreboard)

issues.issue: reverse-angle shot mirrors the picture so in-world text reads backwards
issues.look_for: any sign or label reading backwards
